title: Smoky Italian Casserole
description: A hearty Italian-inspired casserole filled with smoky flavors and topped with a crispy crust.
instructions: Cook casserole noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet, cook smoky sausage over medium-high heat until browned, breaking up with a spoon as it cooks.
Add sliced eggplant to the skillet and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, combine cooked noodles, sausage and eggplant mixture, and cubed bread.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13-inch baking dish.
If using, stir in anchovy paste and parmesan cheese.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until top is golden brown.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve hot.
